headline: The Grob Tea Company Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates — The Grob Tea Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Completion of Acquisition of 100% Equity share of Bazaloni Group Limited, resulting in Bazaloni Group Limited becoming the Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company
